description: Nathan Külling and Antoine Adde publish the population-density component of SWECO25 for Switzerland. The Zenodo ZIP and CSV/XML metadata are free under CC BY 4.0. Using Swiss Federal Statistical Office population points, the collection provides 297 annual raster layers for 2010–2020. It includes neighbourhood means and population sums at thirteen radii between 25 metres and five kilometres. These layers can prepare spatial demand and exposure inputs for infrastructure simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this SWECO25 component. Coverage is national and historical; neighbourhood statistics should not be mistaken for independent population estimates at each radius. Privacy protection replaces source pixel counts of one to four inhabitants with four, and final values are rounded and multiplied by one hundred. Limitations include these transformations, which constrain fine-scale inference and require attention to units. No raster archive was downloaded, population totals reconstructed or agreement with census aggregates checked.
